_what: Commit identifiers recorded in the provenance line of result files, mapped to the commit that carries the same code in the history as it stands now.
_why: The history was rewritten twice on 2026-09-17: once to take an environment variable name out of every commit that mentioned it, and once to drop the measured databases, which are distributed as a release of the shared dataset repository instead. Both rewrites preserved every commit and their order, and neither changed a single file that a run had read, but both changed every identifier after the point they touched. Without this table a recorded number names a commit that no longer exists.
_how_verified: The two rewrites preserved commit count and order (54 and 54; 80 and 80), so each old identifier maps to the commit at the same position. Checked by comparing subject lines at both ends and at four interior positions of each rewrite, including the one commit whose message was deliberately reworded -- an alignment off by one would have placed that message elsewhere.
